== Template:Item/Stats ==

Displays the attribute modifiers in an item tooltip.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''str''' || 0 || Strength modifier
|-
| '''end''' || 0 || Endurance modifier
|-
| '''dex''' || 0 || Dexterity modifier
|-
| '''agi''' || 0 || Agility modifier
|-
| '''int''' || 0 || Intelligence modifier
|-
| '''wis''' || 0 || Wisdom modifier
|-
| '''cha''' || 0 || Charisma modifier
|}

=== Example ===

<pre>
{{Item/Stats
|str=10
|end=15
|dex=12
|agi=8
|int=5
|wis=4
|cha=6
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Stats
|str=10
|end=15
|dex=12
|agi=8
|int=5
|wis=4
|cha=6
}}
